positions.commentary: We see Amphenol as a business to hold with conviction through obstacles and downturns alike, and the risks are mainly cyclical and perceptual, not structural.

thesis: This episode argues that Amphenol is a resilient industrial technology company with a century-long track record of thriving through cycles of electrification, digitization, and reliability demands. The thesis posits that the company is a prime beneficiary of the AI buildout and future technology docking, with its current valuation appearing attractive due to real earnings backing. It concludes that Amphenol is a conviction hold for investors, characterized by cyclical and perceptual risks rather than structural ones.

claims.claim: The company has shown for nearly a century that it is a big new trend in industrial technology and will inevitably participate in electrification, digitization, and demand for reliability.
claims.quote: When I think about opportunities for Amphenol, the truth is, it's really just more of the same. This is a company that has shown for nearly a century that it is a big new trend in industrial technology.

claims.claim: Amphenol has always been there at the critical junction points of power and signal and data, and the opportunity is the continuation of this long-held pattern.
claims.quote: Amphenol has always been there at the critical junction points of power and signal and data. The opportunity is not a single new moonshot. It's the continuation of this long-held pattern, as industrial companies and end markets electrify, digitize and demand more reliability.

claims.claim: Amphenol has been through many cycles over a hundred years and has always proved resilient, even when tariffs were introduced during recent US-China trade tensions.
claims.quote: Amphenol has been through many over a hundred years from post-war collapses to financial crisis to COVID and so forth. Amphenol has always proved resilient, even when tariffs were introduced during the recent US-China trade tensions, the company has been managing this impact very well.

claims.claim: The company has been recognized as a prime beneficiary of the AI buildout, and its multiple premium is below its historical average because its performance has been backed by real earnings.
claims.quote: Over the past 18 months, Amphenol's been recognized as a prime beneficiary of this AI buildout. That's attracted capital and with it, a higher multiple. Interestingly, though, despite fantastic share price performance, relative to the broader GICS tech sector, its multiple premium is below its historical average, and that's because its performance has been backed by real earnings.

claims.claim: We've owned Amphenol for over eight years, and it sits right in the sweet spot for how we invest. It was an exceptional company long before AI, and it will almost certainly remain an exceptional company once the AI cycle matures.
claims.quote: We've owned Amphenol for over eight years, as it sits right in the sweet spot for how we invest. It was an exceptional company long before AI, and it will almost certainly remain an exceptional company once the AI cycle matures.

claims.claim: The opportunity is simply the continuation of a proven pattern of the world electrifies, digitises, or docks new technologies. Amphenol will be a key enabler.
claims.quote: In summary, I would say that the opportunity is simply the continuation of a proven pattern of the world electrifies, digitises, or docks new technologies. Amphenol will be a key enabler.

claims.claim: We see Amphenol as a business to hold with conviction through obstacles and downturns alike, and the risks are mainly cyclical and perceptual, not structural.
claims.quote: The risks are mainly cyclical and perceptual. I wouldn't say structural. And that's why we see Amphenol as a business to hold with conviction through obstacles and downturns alike.
